svg.title: Control Studio tunes the program's own PID
svg.desc: Control Studio starts the program's own PID with its integral term at the 1.962 newton-metre holding torque, so the first torque holds the weight; the automatically designed gains overshoot to 1.25 radians, settle within 0.02 radians from 3 seconds, and the integral term ends holding the weight with 1.962 newton-metres.
svg.text: Control Studio tunes the program's own PID
Control Studio validation run of PositionalPid on the actual ST · weight on the drum · 1 rad step · numbers answer the predictions
Starts at 1.962 N·m: I was set to the holding torque
Peaks 1.25 rad at 0.9 s: no overshoot limit, no setpoint weight
I holds the weight: 1.962 N·m at 1 rad
